description: This file contains hardware layer utilities for input/output pins, including functions for reading pin states, setting pin modes, and managing hardware ports specific to different microcontroller architectures, mainly targeting EFI (Engine Firmware Interface) control code.

methods.name: ioportid_t getHwPort(const char * msg,brain_pin_e brainPin)
methods.description: Returns the hardware port associated with a given brain pin, performing validation and error reporting if the pin is invalid.

methods.name: bool efiReadPin(brain_pin_e pin)
methods.description: Reads the current logic level of a specified hardware pin.

methods.name: void efiSetPadMode(const char * msg,brain_pin_e brainPin,iomode_t mode)
methods.description: Sets the mode (input, output, pull-up, pull-down) for a specified pin, with error handling for previously used pins.

methods.name: iomode_t getInputMode(pin_input_mode_e mode)
methods.description: Converts a custom enum for input modes to the corresponding PAL_MODE constant.

methods.name: void efiIcuStart(ICUDriver * icup,const ICUConfig * config)
methods.description: Starts ICU (Input Capture Unit) with validation, mainly used when HAL_USE_ICU is enabled.
